name: Daylight (DaylightRx)

lifecycle.notes: DaylightRx is a Big Health product - see big-health entry for comprehensive company info

short_description: First FDA-cleared prescription digital therapeutic for generalized anxiety disorder (GAD). 71% improvement rate with Medicare coverage as of January 2025.
long_description: DaylightRx (formerly Daylight) is the first FDA-cleared digital treatment for generalized anxiety disorder (GAD), receiving clearance in September 2024. Developed by Big Health, DaylightRx delivers Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) techniques through an engaging digital program for adults 22+. Clinical trials demonstrate 71% patient improvement rates in anxiety symptoms. Medicare coverage began January 1, 2025 through new CMS Digital Mental Health Treatment (DMHT) G-codes. DaylightRx is distributed through employer wellness programs via PBM integration, with partners including Evernorth and CVS Caremark Point Solutions Management.
one_liner: First FDA-cleared digital therapeutic for GAD with 71% improvement rate.

faqs.q: Is DaylightRx FDA approved for anxiety?
faqs.a: Yes, DaylightRx received FDA clearance on September 4, 2024, becoming the first FDA-cleared digital treatment for generalized anxiety disorder (GAD) in adults 22+.
Yes, Medicare coverage began January 1, 2025 through new CMS Digital Mental Health Treatment (DMHT) G-codes for both Medicare Fee-for-Service and Medicare Advantage.

faqs.q: How effective is DaylightRx for anxiety?
faqs.a: Clinical studies show 71% of DaylightRx patients experience improvement in anxiety disorder symptoms.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Daylight and DaylightRx?
faqs.a: DaylightRx is the FDA-cleared prescription version of Daylight. Big Health also offers employer wellness versions through enterprise partnerships.
